latest_center_screens: The full-center HL33 tongue is nominal geometry only. A seven-axis wood screen finds negative conditional reversible 4D/7D margins, with load-dependent NDS categories and shaped boundaries unresolved. Rearward thickening of all six cut rails to a nominal 4x6 section retains fixed panel-screw receivers but collides at both bottom rails with the header and upper HL33 seats; that rail pose is rejected. Neither result closes G1 or releases drilling. See hardware_first_center_tongue_wood.md and hardware_first_center_thick_rails.md.
latest_rail_relief_screen: Profiled one-piece 4x6 bottom rails remove only added rear wood around header and upper seats; nominal CAD clashes clear and full-thickness rail-side bands remain. No factory bracket or mating seat, bolt group, access or resistance is established. The shared-post stack screen rejects 8-in nominal length with two washers and full nut; longer A307-listed dimensional leads lack explicit Grade A subtype. Both are conditional development evidence, not G1 closure. See hardware_first_center_rail_relief.md and hardware_first_center_post_stack.md.
latest_upper_pair_and_rail_bracket_scree: The same-Y opposing upper HL33 pair is rejected by seat-seat overlap and opposite-principal penetration. Outward translation of unchanged rectangular principals sufficient to separate seats loses fixed center panel screw axes. A bounded exact-retail A66/HL33/UB66 rail bracket shortlist finds no demonstrated all-six installed fit and ordinary-duration resistance. This does not reject every alternative factory-bracket pose. See hardware_first_center_upper_pair.md and rail-factory-bracket-shortlist.md.
latest_upper_stagger_screen: Rearward shifts of both inward upper HL33 brackets by 63.5, 66 and 70 mm retain seat-seat and opposite-principal collisions and lose bore receiving wood at the oblique toes. These sampled poses are rejected; no continuous search or all-bracket verdict. See hardware_first_center_upper_stagger.md.
latest_load_axis_screen: The manufacturer typical-installation drawings map local F1 along the bend/beam axis. In the current outward-X HL33 pose F1 maps to global Y, not X; Simpson publishes no HL F2 transverse value. A paired HL would only address reversible local F1, not any unlisted X action. MiTek B66 publishes F2 but only at C_D=1.6; its documented steel grade can support a separate calculation after a viable installed pose. Current-geometry simultaneous demand directions remain unresolved. See hl-load-axis-audit.md.
gate_summary: G1 remains incomplete. The owner approved hidden frame-member changes while preserving all 66 panel/kicker screw axes, then limited the design to factory brackets (no lap joints). Seven specific center HL35/HL53 poses, one HL33 pose, one B88 pose, one B66 pose, two lower-only paired outer-post HL trials, and one thick-header full-center combination are rejected; none rejects every bracket layout. An integral-tongue full-center HL33 trial now clears nominal CAD collisions while retaining all 66 screw receivers, but is geometry-only and unqualified. Its seam bearing width/tolerance, shared lower post bolt, reversible upper F1 coverage, six rail-to-center connections, installed stacks/access and capacities remain open. Earlier hybrid slides and resected rails do not independently close those issues. MiTek's B88/B66 DXFs supply nominal geometry, not tolerance, and ESR-3455 forbids applying their C_D=1.6 loads to ordinary duration. BR904 and AB205 remain historical. No architecture is selected, six bolted candidate native cases are unrun, and no fabrication is released. See docs/bolted-candidate-owner-inputs.json and docs/bolted-candidate-prototypes/hardware-first-conditional-screen.md.
diagnostic_progress: Separate pre-gate kerf-right diagnostics now include five converged old-connector proxy cases and one converged left-center nominal AB205 topology case at three provisional stiffnesses. A bounded a12-forward left-center attempt did not converge and its forces are excluded. The remaining 22 stations retain proxy connectors; these are not LB-14 candidate solves, rated joint demands, G1/G2 closure, or drilling approval. See docs/bolted-candidate-center-design-convergence.md.
